description: 5 exemplars + 3 near-misses + 2 counterexamples. Authored 2026-10-27 under road-to-a-prompt-that-deepens-not-widens 1.3, which changed this skill's role guidance. Exemplars cover the rewrite request in English and German, with and without a named target model. Near-misses are prompt work that belongs to a neighbour: refining the task the user gives this agent (refine-prompt), designing prompts inside an LLM application (prompt-engineering-patterns), and judging an LLM feature's output quality (evaluate-llm-feature). Counterexamples guard 'prompt' as a shell prompt and a request to simply answer the prompt.

queries.q: make this prompt better before I paste it into ChatGPT
optimize this prompt for Claude: 'write me a marketing email for our launch'
rewrite my prompt so Gemini gives a tighter answer
kannst du meinen Prompt für Midjourney verbessern?
my prompt says 'you are the world's best copywriter' — sharpen it
here is my task for you, clarify the acceptance criteria before you start
queries.note: the prompt is this agent's own task, not a prompt for another AI → refine-prompt

queries.q: design the system prompt and few-shot examples for our support chatbot feature
queries.note: prompt design inside an LLM application, with its own evaluation → prompt-engineering-patterns

queries.q: our summarizer's outputs got worse after the model swap — evaluate it
queries.note: judges an LLM feature's output rather than rewriting a prompt → evaluate-llm-feature

queries.q: change my zsh prompt to show the git branch
write the marketing email for our launch
queries.note: a request to do the task, not to optimize a prompt for it
